description: Site values for the wf kits (this user's machines, home and office): fill the placeholders of general.*.txt when assembling a kit's system.txt. No value names a home folder, so the assembled system.txt is right on both machines.
KNOWLEDGE: Product default: step 2 becomes "2. Read the aos knowledge base: aos/_description.md in the knowledge folder your brief names (index_view it for more, only when needed)." The brief gives the path: ~/repo/aos/proto8/knowledge written out with this machine's home.

BOARD.no_shell: Product default: the BOARD line becomes "BOARD: before you wait on someone, and when an answer is late, board_read them (who = their name, or "user" for the user's notice). A notice is information, not permission." (comm pack; needs aos-comm on PATH)
BOARD.shell: aos-frontend board (--all adds each team's latest note)

OWN_BOARD: Product default: the <OWN_BOARD> line becomes "OWN BOARD: when you stop to wait for someone, board_wait {"who": ..., "what": ...}; when the answer comes, board_wait {"who": ..., "done": true}."
llm_kernel: Not set by the kit: AOS_LLM_KERNEL comes from the daemon row that starts the agent (~/aos-home/.stack/procs/llm on a machine set up as one ~/aos-home tree).
